info.name: paccradle API: capture photo uploads (2026-10-30)
info.description:
Change: M1-D4, uploads and storage (2026-10-30). The client contract moves to **1.0.0-beta.3** (`api-version`); the admin contract stays at 1.0.0-beta.2. Merge into the main contract.

**New:** `POST /api/client/v1/captures` (multipart photo upload) and six error codes: `CAPTURE_FILE_TOO_LARGE` (413), `CAPTURE_UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE` (415), `CAPTURE_UNREADABLE_IMAGE` (400), `CAPTURE_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE` (413), `CAPTURE_IMAGE_TOO_SMALL` (400), `CAPTURE_INVALID_INPUT` (400; `meta.field`, `meta.allowed`). `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` can now name `meta.dependency = "storage"`. Every message is in the caller's language; branch on `code` and fill your own text from `meta`.

formdata.description: JSON settings.
The image file (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

request.description:
Uploads one photo of the product on A4 or Letter paper (CLAUDE.md §3 steps 1–3) and makes a capture waiting for vision. Guests may upload (`POST /auth/guest` first). Send `multipart/form-data` with two parts, in either order:

- `photo`: the image file. JPEG, PNG or WebP; at most **15 MB**, at most **40 megapixels**, at least **1000 px** on the long side. Send the photo the browser re-encoded (≤ 4000 px, JPEG). The type is read from the file's bytes, not from its name or part `Content-Type`.
- `capture`: JSON settings (unknown keys are refused):
  - `paper` (required): `a4` | `letter`.
  - `mode` (required): `photo` | `trace`.
  - `pen_width_mm`: trace mode's pen width, 0.1–3, default 0.5.
  - `height_mm`: the product's height if typed before the photo, 0.1–1000.
  - `exif`: what the browser read from the photo before re-encoding it: `make`, `model` (≤ 100 characters each), `focal_length_35mm` (EXIF `FocalLengthIn35mmFormat`, 5–3000). Any other key is dropped unread: never send a location, but if one slips in it is not kept.

The server keeps the photo **without its metadata**: only the picture, its colour profile and its EXIF orientation stay (no GPS, camera fields, XMP, comments, thumbnails or depth/gain maps). It is private, deleted after 30 days (`photo_kept_until`), and later shown only through 10-minute signed URLs (`GET /captures/{capture_id}`, M1-D5). Outlines and sizes stay after the photo goes.

Limits: `RATE_LIMIT_UPLOADS_PER_HOUR` per user (default 30) and 4 times that per client address; both answer `RATE_LIMITED`.

Until M1-D5 the capture stays `pending`: D5 starts the vision job in the same transaction and adds `GET /captures/{capture_id}` and `POST /captures/{capture_id}/correct`.
